The '''Mindak family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. [[Theovor Mindak]] and his daughter [[Samara Mindak]] were members of the family, and [[Denri Ayl]] met with representatives of the family to arrange purchases. A corporation of the same name sold personal equipment.
